climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A broad, flat valley AVA in San Diego County, set in hills and mountains, with vineyards at about 1,400 feet and 16.5 inches of rain a year. It lies inside the South Coast AVA, and the county's main grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Merlot.
